title: Japanese Pepper Steak
description: A simple and flavorful Japanese-inspired pepper steak recipe with a sweet and savory sauce. Serve with steamed vegetables or a side of rice for a complete meal.

ingredients.name: adventurous
ingredients.amount: 1 cup steak (such as ribeye or sirloin), sliced into thin strips
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality steak for the best flavor

ingredients.name: salad
ingredients.notes: Note: 'salad' is used for the sauce, not as a salad

instructions: 1. In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sugar, and rice vinegar to make the sauce.
2. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
3. Add the sliced pepper and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
4. Add the sliced steak to the skillet and cook for an additional 4-5 minutes, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
5. In the last minute of cooking, pour the sauce over the steak and pepper, and stir to coat.
6. Serve the steak and pepper hot, garnished with sesame seeds and chopped green onions if desired.
